Title: Trace join reports orphans
Requirement: trace.py shall join the SN->SR->LLR->TC registries and, with --strict, exit nonzero if any orphan exists.
Rationale: Realizes SN-002 — the trace is mechanically verified, not asserted by hand (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Thread 47).
AcceptanceCriteria: --strict exits 0 on a fully linked chain and 1 when any SR lacks an LLR/TC, any LLR/TC lacks a parent, or any SN lacks an SR; the orphan list names each at-fault id.

Title: Integrity floor for ids and CSV structure
Requirement: trace.py shall fail --strict-integrity on a duplicated or malformed registry id, a data row whose column count differs from its header, or a TC that pairs an LLR with an SR it does not decompose.
Rationale: Realizes SN-002 — a misaligned or duplicated id corrupts the join before the orphan rules would notice, and an incoherent SR/LLR citation contradicts the LLR's own parent link; wrong at any stage, not just at a gate (the citation-coherence rule is IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Thread 50).
AcceptanceCriteria: --strict-integrity exits 1 on a duplicate/malformed SR/LLR/TC/PB/MOD/PART/ASSET id, a mis-columned row, or an incoherent SR/LLR pairing in one TC, and 0 otherwise; orphans do not affect it.

Title: Placeholder and schema checks
Requirement: trace.py shall, under --no-placeholders, flag any leftover -000 example row, and under --strict-schema, require non-empty required fields and in-vocabulary Verification/Tier values.
Rationale: Realizes SN-022 (a committed placeholder at a gate is a finding) and SN-002 (a real row missing a required cell breaks the trace).
AcceptanceCriteria: --no-placeholders reports every -000 row across SR/LLR/TC and the SN doc; --strict-schema reports an empty required field or an out-of-vocabulary Verification/Tier value.

Title: Acceptance-criteria advisory
Requirement: trace.py shall warn (never fail) when an SR AcceptanceCriteria uses a comparative term with no pinning predicate in the cell.
Rationale: Realizes SN-002 by keeping acceptance criteria testable, while leaving the call to the G1 review — a heuristic lint must not gate.
AcceptanceCriteria: A comparative claim with no pinning predicate marker emits a stdout WARNING and a report line; the exit code is unchanged.

Title: Off-spine registries stay traceable
Requirement: trace.py shall integrity-check the optional off-spine registries (PB/MOD/PART/ASSET) and validate their back-links without blocking a project that does not use them.
Rationale: Realizes SN-002 (off-spine rows stay linked to the spine) and SN-012 (an unused optional registry costs nothing — its -000 row is ignored).
AcceptanceCriteria: A PB row whose Refs name no real SR/LLR/Module, or a MOD row delegating an unknown SR, is a finding; a -000 example row in any of them is ignored.

Title: Gate/tier harness enforces required steps
Requirement: check.py shall run the active gate's required steps and fail the gate when a required tool is missing, reporting SKIP(missing) rather than silently passing.
Rationale: Realizes SN-004 (gates enforce their bar), SN-008 (no false green) and SN-014 (a missing tool fails, never skips).
AcceptanceCriteria: check.py --gate GN runs that gate's steps; a required-but-absent tool yields SKIP(missing) and a nonzero exit; --tier selects the declared step subset.

Title: Declared stack profile
Requirement: check.py shall read the toolchain (format/lint/test commands, tiers, coverage, arch-map mode) from docs/stack.ini so a stack swap edits only that file.
Rationale: Realizes SN-003 — the kit is stack-agnostic; the harness is re-pointed by declaration, not by editing a kit script.
AcceptanceCriteria: check.py resolves each step's command from stack.ini; changing the profile changes the commands run, with no script edit.

Title: Profile validation fails loudly
Requirement: check.py shall fail loudly on a malformed stack.ini, a non-integer coverage threshold, or a missing declared binary, rather than proceeding on a bad profile.
Rationale: Realizes SN-003 and SN-008 — a broken declaration is a red, never a silent misconfiguration.
AcceptanceCriteria: A malformed profile, non-integer coverage, or missing binary produces a clear nonzero failure at the relevant step.

Title: Conditional scaffold profiles
Requirement: bootstrap.py shall seed only the artifacts a chosen profile uses, omitting Python-only files for a non-Python stack.
Rationale: Realizes SN-003 (portability) and SN-012 (right-sizing — a repo gets only what it uses).
AcceptanceCriteria: A non-Python profile omits Python-only artifacts and seeds files-mode arch-map; a minimal selection omits the opt-in layers.

Title: Scaffold runs green out of the box
Requirement: bootstrap.py shall produce a scaffold whose harness runs green immediately after generation.
Rationale: Realizes SN-001 (a working process without hand-building tooling) and SN-007 (the suite bootstraps a real scaffold and exercises every script).
AcceptanceCriteria: bootstrap.py --dest produces a scaffold on which the harness passes; the meta-suite runs every script against that scaffold.

Title: Idempotent re-runnable scaffold
Requirement: bootstrap.py shall be idempotent — a re-run never overwrites an existing file unless --force is passed — and shall stamp docs/kit-version (marked -dirty on an uncommitted kit tree) so a re-sync is a diffable operation.
Rationale: Realizes SN-001 (safe drop-in onto an existing repo) and SN-007 (a re-run to pick up kit updates never regresses the adopter's content). The deliberate kit-vs-project merge is the ADOPTING.md section 6 process — see SR-036.
AcceptanceCriteria: A re-run leaves every existing file (kit- or project-owned) byte-unchanged without --force; --force overwrites; docs/kit-version records the kit SHA + date.

Title: Doc navigability
Requirement: check_docs.py shall fail on a broken intra-repo link or a missing PROJECT-VISION tag, and check generated-doc freshness under --stale.
Rationale: Realizes SN-010 — documentation stays navigable and honest; a broken link or undeclared vision is a red.
AcceptanceCriteria: check_docs.py --stale fails on a dead intra-repo link or absent PROJECT-VISION tag and passes a clean doc set.

Title: Runtime-flows check
Requirement: check_flows.py shall validate that the authored runtime-flow docs conform to their contract.
Rationale: Realizes SN-010 — a hand-authored flow doc that drifts from its contract is caught.
AcceptanceCriteria: check_flows.py passes a conformant flow doc and fails a malformed one.

Title: Perf comparator and budgets
Requirement: check_perf.py shall compare a run against declared budgets and fail when a metric regresses beyond its tolerance.
Rationale: Realizes SN-004 (a measurable gate bar) and SN-012 (perf is an opt-in layer).
AcceptanceCriteria: A metric within tolerance passes; one beyond its budget's tolerance fails at the declared block/warn level.

Title: Performance-budget back-links
Requirement: The performance-budgets registry (PB-###) shall keep every row's Refs resolvable to a real SR/LLR/Module.
Rationale: Realizes SN-002 — the off-spine budget rows stay traceable to the spine.
AcceptanceCriteria: A PB row with an unresolvable or empty Refs is a finding; a resolvable one passes.

Title: No-stub detector
Requirement: check_stubs.py shall detect stub/placeholder markers in source at its declared gate and fail when one is present.
Rationale: Realizes SN-008 — a green never hides a stub.
AcceptanceCriteria: A stub/NotImplemented/pass-only public function at the declared gate fails; clean source passes.

Title: Always-on secrets floor
Requirement: check_privacy.py shall scan every commit's staged diff, message, and outgoing range for secret patterns regardless of the privacy toggle.
Rationale: Realizes SN-009 — a committed secret is caught in every repo without extra setup (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Threads 38/39/44/46).
AcceptanceCriteria: A staged PEM header, token, or key pattern is flagged and blocks; a clean diff passes; the floor runs with privacy-check off.

Title: Privacy gate two-axis
Requirement: check_privacy.py shall add PII/identity classes when docs/privacy-check is on, exempting configured author identities.
Rationale: Realizes SN-009 — the privacy layer is opt-in above the always-on secrets floor (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Threads 44/46).
AcceptanceCriteria: With privacy-check on, an identity/PII class is flagged unless the author is in EXEMPT_EMAILS; with it off, only the secrets floor runs.

Title: Pre-commit hook floor
Requirement: The pre-commit hook shall run the integrity + secrets floor on every commit, agent-neutrally.
Rationale: Realizes SN-005 (the floor is git-enforced, not agent-trusted) and SN-009 (secrets caught before commit) (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Thread 46).
AcceptanceCriteria: The hook runs trace --strict-integrity and the secrets scan on staged content and blocks a commit that fails either.

Title: Pre-push hook outgoing scan
Requirement: The pre-push hook shall scan the outgoing commit range and block a push that would publish a secret or (under privacy-check) a private identity.
Rationale: Realizes SN-005 and SN-009 — the last gate before content leaves the machine.
AcceptanceCriteria: The hook scans the push range and blocks when a secret (always) or an identity/PII class (privacy-check on) appears.

Title: Hook python probe
Requirement: The git hooks shall locate a working python3 by running a candidate and skip-or-report clearly when none resolves or a Store-alias exits nonzero.
Rationale: Realizes SN-013 — no cryptic crash when the interpreter is absent or a Windows Store alias.
AcceptanceCriteria: With no working python3 the hook reports clearly and does not crash; with one, it runs the checks.

Title: Vendored-doc drift
Requirement: check_vendored.py shall detect a vendored copy of an upstream doc drifting from its source.
Rationale: Realizes SN-010 — a stale vendored doc is caught, not silently trusted.
AcceptanceCriteria: A drifted vendored copy is a finding; an in-sync copy passes.

Title: Arch-map generation
Requirement: gen_arch_map.py shall regenerate the symbol map inside its marker block and, under --check, fail when the committed map has drifted from source.
Rationale: Realizes SN-010 and SN-021 — a generated view cannot silently rot; --check makes drift a red.
AcceptanceCriteria: --check fails when the map is stale and passes when current; regeneration rewrites only the marker block.

Title: Permutation case generation
Requirement: gen_cases.py shall expand a Permutations spec into concrete dimensional cases.
Rationale: Realizes SN-002 — dimensional coverage is generated from the SR's declared inputs, not hand-listed.
AcceptanceCriteria: A spec grammar (range/set/bool with @full|@pairwise|@boundaries) yields the expected case set.

Title: Skills index generation
Requirement: gen_skills_index.py shall regenerate skills/INDEX.csv from each SKILL.md applicability frontmatter.
Rationale: Realizes SN-012 (opt-in accelerators) and SN-021 (the index is generated, not hand-maintained).
AcceptanceCriteria: The regenerated INDEX.csv reflects the current SKILL.md frontmatter; a drifted index is detectable.

Title: Coordinator resumes headless
Requirement: agent_loop.py shall resume from docs/status.md and run headless with stdin closed, never blocking on a prompt.
Rationale: Realizes SN-006 (resumable unattended run) and SN-016 (never wedged by a prompt) (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Threads 33/45).
AcceptanceCriteria: The loop reads its next action from docs/status.md and runs with stdin closed; a prompt cannot wedge it.

Title: Coordinator preflight
Requirement: agent_loop.py shall refuse a broken footing in preflight — not a git repo, no agent CLI, or a private author under privacy-check — exiting a typed nonzero code rather than hanging.
Rationale: Realizes SN-006 and SN-015 — a bad footing fails clearly, never hangs (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Threads 33/45).
AcceptanceCriteria: Outside a git repo, with no agent CLI, or with a private author under privacy-check, preflight exits a typed nonzero code.

Title: Coordinator typed outcomes
Requirement: agent_loop.py shall end each session in a typed outcome code, guard a zero-commit HEAD, and report an all-ERROR stall as an unavailable agent rather than a work stall.
Rationale: Realizes SN-006, SN-019 (rev-parse guard) and SN-020 (agent error is not a work stall) (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Thread 45).
AcceptanceCriteria: A repo with no commits does not crash the loop; an agent-CLI error is logged ERROR; an all-ERROR region is reported as an unavailable agent.

Title: Track lock auto-release
Requirement: The per-worktree coordinator lock shall be a kernel advisory lock the OS releases on process death, leaving no stale-pid wedge.
Rationale: Realizes SN-017 — a killed coordinator does not wedge the next run (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Parallel tracks).
AcceptanceCriteria: After the lock holder dies, the next run acquires the lock; no stale-pid file blocks it.

Title: Second coordinator refused
Requirement: agent_loop.py shall refuse a second coordinator in the same checkout, preventing a two-writer race.
Rationale: Realizes SN-018 and SN-006 — mutual exclusion protects the working tree (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Parallel tracks).
AcceptanceCriteria: A second coordinator on a held lock is refused; only one writer runs per checkout.

Title: Declared-policy readers agree
Requirement: The gate-policy, push-policy, and privacy-check readers shall share one declared-value parse so the hooks, agent_loop, and check_privacy agree on the value.
Rationale: Realizes SN-004 (policies drive the gate) and SN-005 (one source, every enforcer reads it the same way).
AcceptanceCriteria: The gate-policy and push-policy readers return the first declared line; every enforcer reads the same value.

Title: Onboarding and dev-setup scaffold
Requirement: The onboarding and dev-setup templates shall scaffold and run green.
Rationale: Realizes SN-001 — a new contributor is onboarded by the generated scripts.
AcceptanceCriteria: The scaffolded onboard/dev-setup scripts run to a green setup.

Title: Release checklist generation
Requirement: gen_release_checklist.py shall emit the release-gate checklist.
Rationale: Realizes SN-004 — the release gate has a generated checklist. No dedicated automated test exists yet; verified by inspection (honest coverage gap, IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md Thread 47 phase 6).
AcceptanceCriteria: Running the script emits the expected release-checklist content; confirmed by inspection.

Title: Scripts are stdlib-only
Requirement: Every kit script shall run on a clean Python 3.8+ with no pip installs (standard library only).
Rationale: Realizes SN-011 — the kit imposes no dependency stack on a downstream repo to run its checks.
AcceptanceCriteria: No kit script imports a third-party package; confirmed by inspecting imports.

Title: Stack-agnostic across OSes
Requirement: The process and ID scheme shall be stack-agnostic and the scripts shall run on Python 3.8+ across Linux, Windows and macOS.
Rationale: Realizes SN-003 and SN-011 — portability is analyzed via the CI matrix, not a single unit test.
AcceptanceCriteria: The CI matrix (Linux/Windows/macOS x Python 3.8/latest) is green; the ID scheme is language-neutral.

Title: Deliberate re-sync integration
Requirement: A re-sync of an existing adoption shall integrate relevant kit updates without clobbering the adopter's filled-in files, per ADOPTING.md section 6 — take kit-owned scripts/hooks wholesale, regenerate generated docs, and preserve filled-in registries/config.
Rationale: Realizes SN-001 and SN-007 — picking up kit updates is a deliberate diff-and-merge, not a mechanical operation: bootstrap.py supplies the docs/kit-version stamp and --force (SR-011), while the operator makes the overwrite-vs-preserve call, aided by the downstream-resync skill.
AcceptanceCriteria: Following ADOPTING.md section 6 against the docs/kit-version diff, kit-owned files are taken wholesale, generated docs regenerated, and filled-in files preserved.
